name: open-doctor
description: Support toolkit for repairing and inspecting local OpenCode data

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --splitting --target=node20.17 --outdir=dist --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --external:better-sqlite3 --external:@opentui/core --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=@opentui/react && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/index.js', 0o755)"
